effect: prove a dependency-free owned browser driver can be built from native Node plus installed Chromium before adding browser code

args:
import json,os,signal,subprocess,tempfile,time,urllib.request
chrome='/usr/bin/google-chrome'
profile=tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='monday-cdp-')
port=9333
p=subprocess.Popen([chrome,'--headless=new','--no-sandbox','--disable-gpu','--remote-debugging-address=127.0.0.1',f'--remote-debugging-port={port}',f'--user-data-dir={profile}','about:blank'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,start_new_session=True)
ok=False
version=None
error=None
for _ in range(80):
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(f'http://127.0.0.1:{port}/json/version',timeout=.2) as r:
            version=json.load(r); ok=True; break
    except Exception as e:
        error=str(e); time.sleep(.1)
try: os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL)
except Exception: pass
try: _,stderr=p.communicate(timeout=2)
except Exception: stderr=''
ws=subprocess.check_output(['node','-p','typeof WebSocket'],text=True).strip()
out={'cdp':ok,'chromium':(version or {}).get('Browser'),'webSocketType':ws,'error':error if not ok else None,'stderrTail':stderr[-1500:]}
open('browser-primitive.json','w').write(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
